title: Assessment of Cardiac Function Using Cardioseismography
summary: The aim of this proposal is to evaluate the innovative technique of cardiosismography in patients with cardiac diseases. This will be achieved, on the one hand, by comparing the results with echocardiographic measurements of cardiac function and, on the other hand, by collecting follow-up data.

interventions.name: To this end, patients who are receiving outpatient or inpatient treatment for heart disease or undergoing a follow-up cardiology examination should undergo cardiosismography in addition to echocardiography.
